prevention_hypothesis: Strict parsing of every Link relation prevents malformed headers from being mistaken for end-of-pagination while preserving standard GitHub next/prev/first/last relations
mandatory_next: Verify 32 focused tests on exact final head with no skips, authenticate complete PR snapshot, independently review against actual GitHub Link syntax, then governed integration; broader mandatory CI and runtime remain BLOCKED
rollback: Normal reviewed revert of the two implementation commits and tests only; retain incident history; no force push
